_provenance.purpose: Part 10b: intraplate velocity used to reduce ETRF2000 coordinates to BGS2005's legal reference epoch (2005.0), per Инструкция № РД-02-20-12/2012 чл.20 + Приложение 6. Still a PROXY for stations other than SOFI.
_provenance.source: EUREF Permanent Network (EPN) station page of SOFI00BGR, 'published by EUREF' tab: positions and velocities from the multi-year solution C2415 expressed in ETRF2000, solution number 4, valid 2023-02-07 to 2026-04-25, epoch t0 2020-01-01
_provenance.release: C2415 (cumulative solution of GPS weeks 0834-2415, covering 1996-01-01 to 2026-04-26)
_provenance.conversion_method: Cartesian ETRF2000 velocity (as published) rotated to the local north/east/up frame at SOFI (lat 42.56, lon 23.39): E = -sin(lon)*vx + cos(lon)*vy; N = -sin(lat)*cos(lon)*vx - sin(lat)*sin(lon)*vy + cos(lat)*vz; U = cos(lat)*cos(lon)*vx + cos(lat)*sin(lon)*vy + sin(lat)*vz.
_provenance.supersedes: north +0.4772 / east +0.2144 / up -0.3590 mm/yr derived on 2026-10-05 from the ITRF2020 velocity (vx -0.01742, vy 0.01844, vz 0.00841 m/yr, EPN SOL.VEL C2415) with the EUREF TN1 Table 4 rates. That conversion was wrong: it disagrees with the ITRF2020 -> ETRF2000 Helmert used by itrf2020_to_bgs2005() (whose time derivative gives north -2.16 / east +0.09 / up -1.13 mm/yr) and with the published ETRF2000 velocity above.
_provenance.validation: 2026-10-25: PPP-AR of the SOFI00BGR daily RINEX of 2026-10-20 (WL 98.2 %, NL 97.2 %) through itrf2020_to_bgs2005() with this velocity differs from the national official ETRS89 position of SOFI (ETRF2000, epoch 2005.0, BAS/MGS, X 4319372.4257 Y 1868687.5403 Z 4292063.7260) by E -3.1 / N -5.7 / U +13.4 mm; with the superseded values it was N -62 mm. See docs/cors_position.md.
_provenance.limitations: A single-station velocity. The ETRF2000 velocity of the Topolchane area can differ by about 1-2 mm/yr (about 2-4 cm over 21.8 years); a station-specific or national velocity model is still needed.
